designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1987 on land bought by The Nature Conservancy and transferred to the Fish and Wildlife Service, to protect bottomland hardwood forest in southeastern Oklahoma.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The 14,216-acre refuge was established in 1987 as the nation’s 438th refuge, and protects one of the largest remaining areas of bottomland hardwood forests found in Oklahoma.
